name: Historic Centre of Bukhara
description: Bukhara is a desert city in Uzbekistan that has stood on the Silk Road for more than 2,000 years. Its old centre is still largely intact, with about 140 monuments, including the massive Ark fortress, the Kalan Minaret and dozens of 17th-century madrasas. The small 10th-century Samanid Mausoleum, made of intricately patterned brick, is among the finest early Islamic buildings anywhere.
